🌀 MazeEscape

You are placed in a maze — find the path from start to exit. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Use arrow keys to navigate through the maze corridors.
  2. Find the path from the start (usually top-left) to the exit.
  3. Use the left-hand rule as a fallback: always turn left when possible.
  4. The maze is randomly generated — memorize the layout as you go.
  5. Reaching the exit completes the maze — try to improve your time.
